correctness.rationale: The equal-weight two-source recursion has exact drift (I+P)QP/2 and conditionally independent bounded Bernoulli innovations. For even d, PQ=-QP gives 4B^2=P^4-P^2. Fourier-pair eigenvalues imply every |lambda|<=1/sqrt(2), ensuring a.s. convergence to half, and yield rho_2=0, rho_6=sqrt(sqrt(3)/8)<1/2, rho_4=1/sqrt(2)>1/2, and rho_d>1/2 for every even d>=8 by the stated cos(pi/8) inequality. Martingale SA CLT with asymptotic variance I/4 gives positive-definite Gaussian covariance at d=2,6 even with nilpotent zero blocks. For every other even d, a selected right eigenprojection divided by its exact gamma product is an L2-bounded martingale because sum t^(-2 Re lambda)<infinity. Its first increment has strictly positive variance ||u||^2/(4|2+lambda|^2), giving sharp nonzero random amplitude. A finite verifier independently tests the polynomial identity and spectrum, not the infinite-time argument.

value.rationale: The equal-weight averaging of two adjacent sampling inputs is a natural minimal departure from the published single-input signed-urn setting. It creates a nonmonotonic sharp threshold: only the six-site ring among sizes greater than two returns to Gaussian fluctuations, while both smaller four and every larger even ring retain a nonzero slower stochastic eigenmode. Proving its amplitude does not vanish is required to distinguish genuine anomalous fluctuations from merely slow deterministic bounds, a motivated unresolved feature of the newer framework.
